## 🐛 Fixed
- **golang.org/x/net 0.62.0**, with the fix for a denial of service in its HTML parser. TowerTorch never uses the parser, so it was out of reach.
- **The fortress kit is at 1.0.1.** An app holding the phrase could announce an address that sent TowerTorch's direct call to another page of a host on your network. The call now always goes where it belongs.
